entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Microsoft nugets version mismatched in preview versions when using EF Core SqlServer #38478

Closed

  • Throw in validation if the DeleteBehavior or requiredness is changed for an ownership. #33625
    Backlog
  • Compiled models generate non-aot compatible code (repro included) #36817
    11.0.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Generate and upload code coverage reports in Build.yml, azure-pipelines-public.yml, and azure-pipelines-internal-tests.yml #38482
  • Reuse CosmosTypeMapping<T>.Default for primitive JSON reader/writers #38481
  • Materialize a left-joined non-entity projection as null on no-match (#30915) #38479
    community-contribution
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38477

Merged

  • Validate that ownership relationships keep their default DeleteBehavior and requiredness #38448
    api-review
  • Make type mapping generic so that it can create value comparers for NativeAOT #38440
    providers-beware, api-review

Updated

  • Unskip tests that aren't failing anymore #38474
  • Fix XML parameter encoding for SQL Server #38462
  • Fix invalid shadow property names in precompiled queries and JSON discriminator metadata #38458
  • Better cast/convert support for Cosmos #35000
    community-contribution
